description: Closes a request typed in the Moontide page without changing the music. Use outcome answered when the request was answered in words, declined when it will not or cannot be done. Give one sentence of at most 200 characters; the page shows it under the request. A change that answers a request names it with answering on set_code, edit_code or restore_version instead. An id that is not an open request is refused and nothing changes.

id.description: The id of the page request to close, from its request line

outcome.description: answered when the request was answered in words, declined when it will not or cannot be done

text.description: One sentence for the user, at most 200 characters; the page shows it under the request

name: answer_request
